# `languages/nix:T160` reads only the WHOLE text of `writeScript` and
# `writeText`, and only its first line: plain text is the config file it
# writes, an interpreter the api does not know (`tclsh`) or one hidden in
# a hole (`runtimeShell`) names no guest, a `+` operand is part of a file
# whose first line is not known, and `writeTextDir` is not on the list.
